text:
kai: heads-up eu-west2c: multiple GPU attaches failing with 'waiting for scratch' starting ~2m ago. Dashboard shows NVMe IO wait and high write amplification. anyone free? :frowning:
ops-bot: ALERT: eu-west2c scratch_iops_utilization 92% for 6m. attach_fail_rate 15%. affected: gpu-provisioner, batch-scheduler.
ravi: i'm on it. quick `iostat -x 1 3` from a sample host:
`nvme0n1 util 99.0%  await 120ms  w/s 320`
looks like janitor compaction + overlayfs flushes coincided with a burst of short-lived training jobs (autoscale).
marta: we recently disabled janitor start jitter in this pool during a debug, and a recent overlayfs tweak increased fsync frequency. combo seems to be trashing drives.
sloane: immediate mitigations: 1) throttle janitor concurrency to 1 2) pause deep-verify 3) add attach admission gate requiring free_scratch_slots>=4. I'll run canary in eu-west2c-a.
kai: please paste the commands so ops has an audit trail. customers queued.
sloane: running now:
```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap janitor-config --patch '{"data":{"concurrency":"1","deepVerify":"false"}}'
kubectl -n infra patch configmap fs-toggles --patch '{"data":{"overlayfs.metadataFlush":"false"}}'
curl -X POST https://provisioner.internal/_admin/policies -d '{"expr":"free_scratch_slots>=4"}'
```
\nops-bot: CHANGE: janitor concurrency set to 1 by sloane at 4932101242. rollback scheduled at 4932101562 if attach errors increase.
ravi: canary shows attach queue drop 200->28 in ~55s, nvme util down to ~65%. good signal.
marta: follow-ups: add an automated pre-scale check that blocks janitor windows within 10m of a large autoscale event and alert if janitor.startJitter==0. owner: infra/storage.
kai: also create a follow-up to make provisioner admission consider per-node iops_budget, not just slot count. owner: infra/provisioner.
sloane: agreed. i'll roll to remaining AZs with 20s spacing. monitoring for 15m and then gradual re-enable of deep-verify with high jitter.
kai: thanks all. keep this thread for the postmortem checklist and timeline. :thumbsup:
